annotations.title: Get the panchang for a city

description: Calculates the Hindu panchang for one day in one city: weekday, tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana with the time each ends, Moon sign, sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset, lunar month, Rahu Kaal and the other daily time windows, and the day's observances. Use it when someone asks for today's panchang, tithi, nakshatra, Rahu Kaal or sunrise for a place. Times are in the city's own time zone. Covers today by default, or another date.

date.description: Optional. The day as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in that city. Convert the person's own wording to this form; if an all-number date could be read two ways, ask which number is the day.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the city in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the city in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.

place.description: City and country, for example "Pune, India".

name: get_panchang
title: Get the panchang for a city
